patch.summary: Amplemarket cost guide: researched plan structure, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Amplemarket pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Free plan: not confirmed in SG data

blocks.title: Amplemarket plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Startup
lines.description: Trial available · up to 2 included users, up to 27,000 contacts · Unlocks: prospecting, data enrichment, lead management · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Growth
lines.description: Trial available · up to 4 included users, up to 140,000 contacts · Contact sales · Unlocks: built-in calling · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

lines.label: Elite
lines.description: Trial available · up to 10 included users, up to 400,000 contacts · Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.heading: Amplemarket cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Amplemarket against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (prospecting, data enrichment, email sequences) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Outbound-led B2B teams investing in AI multichannel engagement requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.
Side-by-side cost with Apollo.io on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Startup already list price annual; Growth/Elite are custom-quoted.

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Contact volume and included seats differ sharply by plan (27k / 140k / 400k contacts).

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Duo Voice called out on Growth packaging versus Startup.

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not a CRM pipeline system of record

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Amplemarket on identical constraints.

blocks.title: Model sales-intelligence spend with Amplemarket in mind
blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for Amplemarket alongside category cost modelling.
